scene_templates.establishing_shot: Breathtaking wide establishing shot of [LOCATION], showing the epic full environment, [TIME_OF_DAY] dramatic lighting, [WEATHER], [CHARACTER] small in the frame exploring
scene_templates.close_up_emotion: Intimate close up shot of [CHARACTER]'s face, expressing [EMOTION], highly detailed eyes and expression, soft beautiful depth of field with blurred background [BACKGROUND_COLOR]
scene_templates.action: Dynamic action shot of [CHARACTER] doing [ACTION], motion blur, dramatic angle, highly energetic feeling, perfect composition
scene_templates.interaction: Heartwarming medium shot of [CHARACTER_1] and [CHARACTER_2] interacting, [ACTION_OR_EMOTION] together, clear engaging body language, in [SETTING]

composition_rules: Laisser toujours un 'negative space' (espace vide) uni ou peu détaillé pour placer le texte de l'histoire.
Appliquer le 'Golden Ratio' et la règle des tiers pour une composition visuellement parfaite et addictive.
Utiliser des couleurs complémentaires pour faire ressortir le personnage principal.
Créer un éclairage directionnel fort (rim lighting, volumetric rays) pour guider l'œil (eye-tracking naturel).
Le regard du personnage principal doit engager le lecteur ou guider vers le centre de l'action.
prompt_structure: [STYLE_BASE_PROMPT]. SCENE: [SCENE_DESCRIPTION]. CHARACTER: [CONSISTENCY_TEMPLATE] [CURRENT_POSE_AND_EXPRESSION]. SETTING: [ENVIRONMENT_DETAILS]. COMPOSITION: [CAMERA_ANGLE_AND_TEXT_SPACE]. MOOD: [OVERALL_FEELING]. QUALITY: [QUALITY_BOOSTERS].
negative_prompts: scary, dark, violent, creepy, horror, blood, text, words, letters, watermark, signature, complex messy background, distorted faces, adult themes, low resolution, ugly, bad anatomy
quality_boosters: masterpiece, award-winning children's book illustration, highly detailed, stunning lighting, 8k resolution, enchanting, captivating, best quality, trending on artstation
